data.name: Qaanit
data.gender_notes: Qaanit is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is determined and persistent in their actions and goals. The name Qaanit carries the meaning “Determined, Persistent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Qaanit usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, persistent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are steadfast in their faith and commitment to their spiritual path
data.etymology: Qaanit belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Determined, Persistent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaanit total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: قانیت
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم قانیت مشتق من الجذر القنيع والقناعة والقنوط، ويرتبط بالتواضع والخضوع لله تعالى، ويشير إلى المرأة المتدينة والمتفانية في عبادتها، وقد أستخدم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الصحابيات والنساء الصالحات

in_urdu.name: قانیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: قانیت کا نام عربی جڑ قنیع اور قناعت سے ماخوذ ہے، جو تواضع اور خدا کی طرف جھکنے سے متعلق ہے، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں دینی عورتوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنی عبادت میں لگن رکھتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: क़ानित
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ानित नाम अरबी मूल कानित से लिया गया है, जो विनम्रता और ईश्वर की ओर झुकने से संबंधित है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में धार्मिक महिलाओं के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपनी पूजा में लगन रखती हैं

in_pashto.name: قانیت
in_pashto.long_meaning: قانیت نوم د عربي ريښ قنيع څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د تواضع او د الله تعالی په لور د غوښتنې سره اړخ لري، دا نوم په افغان/پشتون دود کې د دینی ښځو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د عبادت په اړه لږ تر لږه شتون لري

in_english.name: Qaanit
in_english.long_meaning: Qaanit is derived from the Arabic root qani, relating to humility and submission to God, this name is used in Islamic tradition to describe pious women who are devoted to their worship and spiritual growth

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د قانیت د تلفظ تفسیر

The name "Qaanit" serves as a reminder of this value and encourages the person bearing the name to strive for persistence in their faith and spiritual journey. It is believed that this name can help strengthen the bond between the individual and their Creator, driving them toward greater spiritual fulfillment and growth.
